checklist_desc: Every pre-packaged commodity in India must carry these declarations clearly:
rule_a_summary: Manufacturer / Packer name and complete address with PIN code.
rule_b_summary: Generic / common name of the commodity.
rule_c_summary: Net Quantity in standard SI units (g, kg, ml, l, N).
rule_e_summary: MRP with currency & 'inclusive of all taxes'.
rule_g_summary: Country of Origin (Mandatory for all products).
decision_support_desc: SmartPack-LM accelerates verification for field inspectors. The AI does not make final legal determinations.
